source: Y. Ashrafyan, D. A. Gomes, A fully-discrete semi-Lagrangian scheme for a price formation MFG model, arXiv:2403.02785v2 (30 Jan 2025), §8, Tables 1 (p. 24) and 2 (p. 27); read from the PDF on 2026-09-07
definition: relative errors in l∞ norms: ϖ over the time grid, u at t = 0 over the space grid, m at t = T over the space grid; ρ = 2h; all cases converging within 4 (test 1) or 3 (test 2) iterations of steps 1–4

printedPrice.test1: ϖ(t) = η(τ − ∫x m̄)(T − t) − η∫ₜᵀ∫₀ˢQ(r) dr ds − cQ(t)

printedDensity: m̂(x) = exp(−1/(1 − (λx)²)) for |x| < 1, 0 otherwise — as printed the exponent is positive and unbounded on 1/λ < |x| < 1 and the integral diverges; the integrable reading is support |x| < 1/λ
